Class Rocket

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.player.Rocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Rocket extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player's rocket on the game's gameboard, which can be assigned a color and position. The rocket can move across the board while handling collisions with other rockets.
